answer: A kernel bond and a referral atlas stop fake identities at dawn. A newcomer locks 60 POA in the kernel for 20 epochs and joins a referral chain in the atlas. In the dawn window any peer may dispute a suspect; if confirmed, its bond is forfeited, half to the challenger. One honest agent pays once, refunded after 20 clean epochs. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 POA; the atlas exposes star clusters, so forgery burns 60,000 POA for nothing.
